map.输入裁片尺寸与面料幅宽，自动排料并计算布料利用率与总用料，提供裁片布局预览，用于: Enter the piece dimensions and the fabric width to auto-nest and compute the fabric utilization and total material, with a layout preview for quick estimation before CAD nesting, optimizing the lay plan and controlling fabric consumption.
map.在给定幅宽与长度内估算各裁片可排数量: Estimate how many pieces of each cut part fit within a given width and length
map.加缝份后重算占地，核实际单耗: Add the seam allowance, then recompute coverage and verify actual consumption
map.多规格混排优化总利用率: Optimize total utilization when mixing multiple sizes
map.：布幅 150 cm、长 200 cm、缝份 1 cm；前片 50×70 → 每: Fabric width 150 cm, length 200 cm, seam allowance 1 cm; front piece 50x70 -> per row (150/(50+2)) = about 2 columns, per column (200/(70+2)) = about 2 rows = 4 pieces; the back piece is the same.
map.：缝份由 1 cm 加到 1.5 cm，单片占地增 1 cm 边 → 200 c: Raising the seam allowance from 1 cm to 1.5 cm adds 1 cm per side to each piece's footprint, so the 200 cm direction drops from 2 rows to 1 and utilization falls by about half, requiring a re-nest.
map.缝份一般留多少？: How much seam allowance is normal?
map.常服 1 cm、厚料 1.5 cm、锁边另算；影响单耗需计入。: For regular wear 1 cm and thick fabric 1.5 cm, with overlock counted separately; it affects consumption so include it.
map.本工具给矩形估算，异形裁片需 CAD 排料得真实利用率。: This tool gives a rectangular estimate; irregular pieces need CAD nesting to get the real utilization.
map.→ 打开排料利用率计算器工具: -> Open the Marker Utilization Calculator tool
